name: Leica Lukin: Through The Aperture
source:
Leica and 7 other people are trapped in a mansion by an unknown person, then forced to solve one mystery: the murder of the mansion's last known resident, Alice Hargrave.

[From [url=https://coiny.itch.io/through-the-aperture]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莱卡和其他7个人被身份不明的人困在一座宅邸中，然后被迫解开一个谜团：宅邸最后一位已知居民爱丽丝·哈格雷夫被谋杀。

[来自[url=https://coiny.itch.io/through-the-aperture]itch.io[/url]]
